scope: Explicit structural queries, not exhaustive chemical taxonomy or pharmacology classifications. Core queries ignore bond order and stereo only where explicitly documented.

definitions.name: Arylcyclohexylamines
definitions.description: Six-carbon ring with an amine and an aromatic or heteroaromatic attachment on the same saturated carbon; ring carbonyls permitted.

definitions.name: Ergoline cores
definitions.description: Ergoline fused-ring connectivity; bond order and stereochemistry are not membership criteria.

definitions.name: Dibenzopyran cores
definitions.description: Dibenzopyran ring connectivity, including partially hydrogenated forms; no cannabinoid activity inferred.

definitions.name: Tropane cores
definitions.description: 8-Azabicyclo[3.2.1]octane connectivity; stereo and substituents do not establish a shared action.

definitions.name: Morphinan cores
definitions.description: Morphinan ring connectivity, including bridged and oxygen-substituted relatives; no opioid action inferred.

definitions.name: Benzimidazolones
definitions.description: Benzimidazol-2-one motif, including substituted ring nitrogens; distinct from nitazene benzimidazoles.

definitions.name: Barbiturates
definitions.description: Pyrimidine-2,4,6-trione ring; this query excludes thiobarbiturates.

definitions.name: 1,4-Benzodiazepin-2-ones
definitions.description: A defined 1,4-benzodiazepin-2-one subset; fused triazolo and other benzodiazepine subtypes can be absent.

definitions.name: 1,3-Benzodioxoles
definitions.description: A benzene-fused 1,3-dioxole ring; structural membership only.
